apple-sweet-potato-puree.basis: 1 sweet potato and 1 apple: about 4 small portions.

baking-chocolate-cake.basis: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 cups sugar, and 2 eggs: about 12 cake slices.

chewy-oat-cookies.basis: 3 cups rolled oats, 1 cup raisins, and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour: about 12 portions.

crispy-skin-salmon.basis: 4 skin-on salmon fillets with 1 head little gem lettuce, 1 watermelon radish, and 1 avocado: 4 portions.

day-old-fried-rice.basis: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice, 3 eggs, and 4 oz char siu or ham: about 3 portions.

indian-dal-tadka.basis: 1 cup toor dal with 3 cups water, 1 onion, and 2 tomatoes: about 4 portions.

lime-shrimp-tacos.basis: 1 lb shrimp and 8 corn tortillas: about 4 dinner portions.

multi-component-mole.basis: 6 bone-in chicken thighs: about 6 dinner portions.

overnight-chickpea-stew.basis: 1 cup dried chickpeas, 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes, and 4 cups vegetable stock: about 4 portions.

spicy-harissa-pasta.basis: 12 oz rigatoni with 3 tbsp harissa olive oil, 2 tbsp tomato paste, and 1/4 cup heavy cream: about 4 dinner portions.

sunday-roast-dinner.basis: 1 whole chicken (about 1.8 kg / 4 lb) with 1.2 kg (2 1/2 lb) floury potatoes and 300 g (10 oz) green beans: about 4 dinner portions.

weeknight-shakshuka.basis: 6 eggs in a sauce of 1 can (28 oz) whole tomatoes, 1 onion, and 2 red bell peppers: about 3 portions.

weeknight-stir-fry.basis: 1 lb chicken thighs, 1 red bell pepper, and 1 cup snap peas: about 3 dinner portions.

yogurt-marinated-chicken.basis: 8 bone-in chicken thighs: about 4 dinner portions.

herb-salt.basis: 3 tbsp flaky sea salt, 2 sprigs rosemary, and 1 lemon: about 24 condiment portions.

zucchini-wraps.basis: 2 zucchini, 1 onion bulb, 1 garlic scape, and frozen parathas: about 2 portions.
